tables.name: tt
tables.columns: k UInt64, d DateTime, u0 UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64

inserts.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number AS k, now() + 3 AS d, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2 FROM numbers({rows})

description: One insert of 100 000 rows whose d expires 4 s after the insert (TTL d + INTERVAL 1 SECOND, merge_with_ttl_timeout = 1); the window waits until the TTL merge has emptied the table and every part is removed.
